title: Financial Statements & Reporting
description: Read, prepare, and interpret income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Tests financial literacy and reporting accuracy.

seo.overviewTitle: Financial Statement Preparation & Reporting under IFRS for SMEs
seo.overviewBody: Preparing accurate financial statements is essential for statutory compliance and investor confidence. Financial accountants demonstrate expertise in drafting full sets of financial statements under IFRS for SMEs: Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flows, Equity Changes, and Disclosure Notes.

deliverables.title: 1. IFRS-Compliant Financial Statement Model
deliverables.desc: Integrated Excel financial statement model (.xlsx) producing fully linked Balance Sheet, P&L, and Cash Flow statements.

deliverables.title: 2. Accounting Policies & Disclosure Notes Document
deliverables.desc: Statutory notes detailing significant accounting policies, revenue recognition rules, and asset depreciation schedules.

deliverables.title: 3. Trial Balance Audit Reconciliation Sheet
deliverables.desc: Year-end trial balance working papers linking general ledger accounts to final financial statement line items.

faqs.question: What are the main differences between Full IFRS and IFRS for SMEs?
faqs.answer: IFRS for SMEs simplifies measurement rules, eliminates non-relevant accounting topics (like earnings per share and segment reporting), and significantly reduces mandatory disclosure note requirements.

faqs.question: How is revenue recognized under IFRS accounting standards?
faqs.answer: Revenue is recognized when control of goods or services is transferred to the customer in an amount reflecting the expected consideration.

faqs.question: How are Property, Plant, and Equipment (PPE) accounted for under IAS 16 / Section 17?
faqs.answer: PPE is initially recorded at cost, then systematically depreciated over its estimated useful life down to its residual value.
